description: List every version of a Zenodo deposit's version series, newest first, with each version's record id, DOI, version label, publication date, file totals, and usage counts. Accepts any identifier zenodo_get_record accepts; a concept DOI and any single version's DOI list the same series. Use it to find the version a paper cited or the current release. A miss (an unknown id, a deleted record with its removal tombstone, restricted metadata, or a DOI not registered on Zenodo) returns found: false with guidance instead of an error.

id.description: Any version or concept identifier of the deposit: a record id (22705923), a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.22705923) or concept DOI (10.5281/zenodo.591564), another DOI registered to a Zenodo record, or a zenodo.org/records or doi.org URL.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1. page × size may not exceed 10,000.

name: zenodo_list_versions

concept_doi.description: Concept DOI of the series, when minted; absent when not found or on a page past the end.

concept_recid.description: Concept record id naming the whole series; absent when not found or on a page past the end.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identifier`: id matches no accepted form, or is a GitHub-badge latestdoi id or a non-zenodo.org host. `result_window_exceeded`: page × size exceeds 10,000. `record_unavailable`: Zenodo could not serve this record or its versions page: HTTP 500 after one retry, HTTP 500 while resolving a non-Zenodo DOI, or no complete record response within the time budget (its gateway cuts off near 30 s, which deposits with about 10,000 or more files hit). `upstream_timeout`: The versions page got no complete response within its time budget. `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when the version series resolved.

guidance.description: What to do next. Present when not found.

has_more.description: True when another page of versions follows.

input_kind.description: How id was parsed: record_id (digits), zenodo_doi (10.5281/zenodo.N or zenodo.N), external_doi (another DOI), or url (a zenodo.org or doi.org link).

latest_recid.description: Record id of the newest version. Present when found, unless Zenodo cannot name it for a page past the end.

miss_kind.description: Why nothing resolved. Present when not found.

next_page.description: The next page number, when has_more.

notice.description: Guidance on paging or a page past the end.

tombstone.description: Removal tombstone. Present when miss_kind is deleted.

citation_text.description: The citation the tombstone still serves — the only bibliographic data a deleted record keeps.

removal_reason.description: Removal reason id, e.g. spam or retracted.

totalCount.description: Number of versions in the series.

total_versions.description: Number of versions in the series. Present when found.

truncated.description: True when more versions follow this page.

versions.description: Versions on this page, newest first; empty when not found.

doi.description: DOI of this version; absent on some old records.

downloads.description: Unique downloads of this version; absent when not reported.

file_count.description: Number of files; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

index.description: Position in the series (1 = first version); absent if Zenodo omits version data.

is_latest.description: True for the newest version; absent if Zenodo omits version data.

publication_date.description: Publication date (EDTF as given); absent when not recorded.

recid.description: Record id of this version — feeds zenodo_get_record id.

total_bytes.description: Total file size in bytes; absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

version.description: Version label as deposited; absent when the depositor set none.

views.description: Unique views of this version; absent when not reported.

title: List Zenodo record versions
